description: Boot banner and Hello <n> on USART3 (ST-LINK VCP), captured on the macOS host after an SWD reset

firmware.built_with: cmake --preset Debug (CubeMX CMakePresets.json), not yet via make fw

capture.reset: st-flash reset (SWD), stale VCP bytes drained before reset
capture.timestamps: host wall clock (Time::HiRes), per USB read; ~+/-3 ms jitter

results.notes: Board time runs ~1.3% fast relative to the host clock; cause not yet investigated (see README section 6).
